Stephanie / Marissa —

Thanks for the ping. Legal has looked through the redline and the ask to explicitly authorize Cloud Partner Asia as an operator is fine in principle. A few required items before we can sign off and provide a short-form certificate:

Required artifacts from Cloud Partner Asia (or MedBridge if they are facilitating):
- Current SOC 2 Type II report with scope that includes the APAC processing environment (we need date ranges).
- Subprocessor roster (technical contact and org contact).
- KMS boundary diagram and details on key custody (we require customer-controlled KMS for regulated PHI unless explicitly waived).
- Network segmentation and cross-border egress controls (how will the partner prevent inadvertent egress to non-APAC regions?).
- Incident response contact and SLAs for failover/egress events.

Operational comments / timeline (Ops input would finalize this, but my read):
- If the SOC2 scope is standard and the partner provides the roster and a KMS separation design, we can issue an operator authorization letter and a residency attestation within ~10 business days. That letter would be an addendum to the DPA referencing the partner by legal entity name and enumerating permitted processing scopes and failover windows.
- If the SOC2 scope is missing APAC components or the KMS model doesn't meet the customer requirement, we'll need either a compensating controls package or a longer review (3–4 weeks).

Suggested next steps (action items):
1) Request the artifacts above from MedBridge and Cloud Partner Asia. (Tara, can you coordinate delivery?)
2) Marissa to confirm the ops checklist and whether the partner requires on-site audit or remote evidence only.
3) Legal will prepare a short operator authorization template + certificate once artifacts are validated.

I'll prepare a draft operator authorization letter and a short-form residency attestation template and drop it into the shared drive. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/security/region-pinning-spec (private to legal & ops).

If we get the artifacts by EOD next Wed (Aug 4), target issuance by Aug 16 — which would meet MedBridge's Aug 20 board window assuming no escalations.
